definitions.explanation: Rigidly adhering to rules, deadlines, or regulations without exception. Implies zero tolerance for deviation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{厳守|げんしゅ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{厳守|げんしゅ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧します。
⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{厳守|げんしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる。
examples.english: Strict observance of safety rules helps prevent accidents.

notes:
{厳守|げんしゅ} means to observe or comply with something strictly, with zero tolerance for deviation. It is stronger than simply "following" rules — it implies absolute adherence.

FORMS:
{厳|げん} (strict) + {守|しゅ} (protect, observe)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{厳守|げんしゅ}: strict punctuality (very common compound)
- ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧{厳守|げんしゅ}: strict deadline compliance
- ⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{厳守|げんしゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to strictly observe rules
- {厳守|げんしゅ}⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧: items to be strictly followed
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{厳守|げんしゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to strictly observe the law

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {厳守|げんしゅ}: strict observance (strongest, zero tolerance)
- ⟦{遵守|じゅんしゅ}→遵守：06107_junshu⟧: compliance, observance (formal, common in legal contexts)
- ⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to follow, to protect (everyday, general)

REGISTER:
Formal. Frequently appears in workplace notices, official documents, school rules, and announcements. ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{厳守|げんしゅ} is especially common on meeting invitations and event notices.
